definitions.full: H976. bochan בֹּ֫חַן noun [masculine] testing , Isa 28:16 בֹּחַן אֶבֶן a tested, tried stone , i.e. approved for use as a foundation-stone. On Ezek 21:18 ᵑ0 see foregoing near the end.

occurrences.englishText: Therefore the Lord Yahweh says, “Behold, I lay in Zion for a foundation a stone, a tried stone, a precious cornerstone of a sure foundation. He who believes shall not act hastily.
